Print an mvgam object

Source: R/print.mvgam.R
print.mvgam.Rd

Print an mvgam object

Usage

# S3 method for class 'mvgam'
print(x, ...)

Arguments

x

mvgam object returned from mvgam(), fitted or built with run_model = FALSE

...

Unused. Anything passed here is refused.

Value

The mvgam object is returned invisibly.

See also

summary.mvgam() summarises the posterior of each parameter. methods_md() writes the model as equations. how_to_cite() drafts its methods paragraph.
